title: Cloncurry Post Office
axis: +X follows the frontage toward Sheaffe Street. +Z faces Scarr Street.

nativeAxes.x: roughly east along the office frontage

source: Named OpenStreetMap office way 462782527, office node 1916584568 and Queensland Heritage Register entry 600416.
identityStatus: The named office footprint contains the current postal node and agrees with the register address. The OSM start date of 1885 conflicts with the register’s 1906 new office date and is not used to date the model. The present rectangle includes building fabric changed since 1910. Only the street front and broad site extent are native controls.
geometryLabel: Four present-day office footprint corners, with approximate historical roof and porch subdivisions

terrainContact.basis: Public source elevation near the street-facing steps.

notes: The timber twin-porch and central-gable Cloncurry Post Office around 1910, after its 1906 construction. Includes the raised original office, verandahs, steps and corrugated hip roof. The separate postmaster’s residence and later exchange additions are outside this historical exterior. The photograph shows an open pair of porches beside the projecting gable. Historical depth, rear windows, and colors require estimates.
